exposure: maternal exposure to fine particulate matter (PM2.5) in coal mine fire smoke
cohort: The study included 3612 singleton pregnancies of women with births >20 weeks in the Latrobe Valley, Australia, between March 1, 2012, and December 31, 2015.
finding: An interquartile range increase in peak PM2.5 exposure was associated with a 16% increased likelihood of gestational diabetes mellitus, with second-trimester exposure being critically important.
